plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
runtime: node 22, express, PostgreSQL 18 (openvibe-sdk/db, async) + Valkey 9, ffmpeg
pastes: OpenVibe.Community is the paste authority since 2026-09-22 (PASTES_FROZEN_APPS=live, PASTES_MOVED_TO); the paste routes stay as the rollback path
deployment: Public at https://openvibe.media: deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy media` (restart refused while a VOD records; --wait-idle), /opt/openvibe.media, unit openvibe-media on 127.0.0.1:4100 behind the openvibe.media nginx vhost, principal media.
features: VOD recording (RTMP pull, RTP ingest), chunk ingest and finalize
storage tiering local, Backblaze B2, Cloudflare R2 with copy verification and a disk guardian
canonical object model (/api/v2) with namespaces, holds, derivatives and lifecycle
media jobs with leases, retries and proposals
multi-tenant apps and developer-project tenants (sandbox separated)
public serving with presigned URLs; signed access for private and sandbox items
the object explorer (/me) and operator views
media.* events through the SDK outbox, webhooks during the transition
restore-drill mode and N-1 compatibility tests
